title: Transform: Records to Labels
prompt: students = [{"name": "Minh", "score": 8}, {"name": "Lan", "score": 5}] (0-10 scale). Write to_labels(students) returning a NEW list of strings "name: pass" when score >= 6 else "name: retake".

tests.name: new list built
tests.code:
students = [{"name": "Minh", "score": 8}, {"name": "Lan", "score": 5}]
assert to_labels(students) == ["Minh: pass", "Lan: retake"], f"got {to_labels(students)}"
assert to_labels([{ "name": "B", "score": 6}]) == ["B: pass"], "6 is a pass (>= 6)"
assert to_labels([]) == [], "empty students -> empty labels"
tests.hint: build a result list with append inside the loop — never mutate the input dicts.
